subject.title: Skill-draft semantic dedup: duplicate drafts with different hash suffixes

question: Which Skill Research proposal-novelty contract should OpenClaw support for repeated auto-created skill drafts?
rationale: The current code clearly lacks semantic coalescing, but the choice between deterministic provenance/upsert behavior and embedding-based similarity affects persisted proposal semantics, performance, and reviewer expectations.

options.title: Fold into the capture invariant
options.body: Use the active autocapture PR to add current-turn provenance, replay suppression, and auto-capture-owned pending proposal upsert/revise before considering embeddings.

options.title: Add semantic similarity coalescing
options.body: Implement the requested embedding threshold and duplicate counter as an explicit proposal metadata contract with tests, docs, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Defer core coalescing
options.body: Keep exact skillKey suppression and manual reject/quarantine workflows until maintainers have stronger live evidence or a broader skill lifecycle design.

recommendation.title: Fold into the capture invariant
recommendation.body: Use the active autocapture PR to add current-turn provenance, replay suppression, and auto-capture-owned pending proposal upsert/revise before considering embeddings.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already gave concrete capture-invariant direction on the active related PR and has recent adjacent /learn and Skill Workshop prompt commits.
